name: Black Spire Outpost transport
description: A transport shuttle operating out of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu carried passengers from the surface to ships in space and back, including the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon. The vessel was piloted by RX-Series pilot droid J6-F8. The transports were provided by Oga Garra, and could be boarded at the cruise ship's Transport Dock on Deck 6.
